title: Not ADHD friendly
body: It’s a really complicated app for someone who has ADHD/ADD as it just gives you more things to do. You need to make sure your calendars are synced. Even though you add a new calendar block like a lunch break it does not book it on your calendar even though it says it did. It can block your energy levels on your external calendar which is the most visually anxiety providing look ever. The AI chat feature feels very outdated, it wants you to confirm everything and gives long answers for unnecessary moments which is not very ADHD friendly. The identified energy levels fo not have any explanation meaning I just do not believe in it. I think it is a great idea but needs a lot of work and is not worth to pay 60 euros a year for this version.
author: Kghkdhkchckcho
